spec.name: sprint47_taker_imbalance_slow_flow_majors
spec.hypothesis: Sustained extreme taker-buy share (4h smoothed, z>3 vs 30d) predicts 12h continuation in liquid USDT majors; prior taker_imbalance specs used short holds. New mechanism: multi-hour lag per EFMA 2025.
spec.power_argument: 6 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap 1/day gives <=~550 entries; effective n after cross-symbol correlation is likely ~300. Assumed 12h sigma ~120bp (estimate, not measured), so SE ~7bp at n=300 and MDE at t=2 is ~14bp. T2 round trip is ~26bp, so PASS needs gross >~40bp, which can fail under the null. If validation n<300, mark UNPOWERED and do not score.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
